_readme: Update policy, compared against the BUILD number (the +N in pubspec.yaml). latestBuild = dismissible prompt. minBuild = BLOCKING. FORCING NEEDS BOTH, and needs the build to be LIVE first: raising minBuild against a store still serving an older build blocks a user, sends them to update, and blocks them again. The client guard that downgrades that mistake to a prompt only exists in app build 103+, so the users it would strand are exactly the ones without it. latestVersion MUST match the version string the store actually reports, not the one in pubspec.yaml: iOS blocks only when latestVersion <= the live App Store version, so claiming a version the store does not serve silently disables enforcement. Build 108 shipped on iOS under an App Store version entry labelled '1.6' (the build's own CFBundleShortVersionString is 1.7.1), which is why ios.latestVersion reads 1.6. ANDROID IS STILL IN REVIEW as of this change - leave it at 1 until Play has approved AND rolled out to 100%, then set both to 108 with latestVersion matching the Play listing.
